name: graph-rag-diabetes

scripts.deploy:frontend: cd packages/infrastructure && npx aws-cdk deploy FrontendStack
scripts.deploy:backend: cd packages/infrastructure && npx aws-cdk deploy GraphProcessingStack
scripts.deploy:medkg: cd packages/infrastructure && npx aws-cdk deploy MedKnowledgeGraphStack
scripts.smoke: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['README.md','docs/setup.md','.env.example','packages/lambda/.env.example','packages/frontend/.env.example','packages/infrastructure/.env.example','packages/lambda/src/local_http_server.py']; const missing=files.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f)); if(missing.length){console.error('Missing required files: '+missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('Smoke check passed');"

description: Graph-RAG system for evidence-based diabetes care
